hypothesis.title: Depth-stratified USGS MT conductance discontinuities
hypothesis.mechanism: A laterally coherent conductance edge or termination that changes between depth slices may mark a buried fault/fluid pathway beneath basin fill; emit only where a depth-persistent structural break is supported, not on broad high-conductance blobs.
hypothesis.named_non_fault_mimic: Saline playa/basin brine or a non-fault lithologic contact can create a conductance boundary.
hypothesis.expected_holdout_benefit: Qualitative projection only: potentially small-to-moderate positive if resolved depth breaks align with withheld faults; neutral or negative if the regional fields are too smooth or lithologic/fluid mimics dominate. No numeric projection or score assigned.
